verification.comparison: Field names and issue labels normalized to the existing AuditDataset oracles; PHP not modified or replayed.

turns.prompt: Use Symfony Code Mode to audit every published article in the Symfony fixture for missing meta descriptions or missing hero-image alt text. Return the affected article IDs and titles with their issues, and the total number audited. Use the MCP tools rather than repository files. Keep this read-only. Show the PHP you actually submit and summarize the host-recorded tool calls. Use one php_execute call so we retain the second execution for a follow-up.

items.text: I’ll discover the article schema through Symfony Code Mode, then submit one read-only PHP audit. I’ll show the submitted PHP, the affected articles, and the host-recorded calls.

arguments.query: published articles meta description hero image alt text pagination

structuredContent.name: cms_get_articles
structuredContent.description: Read metadata for up to 12 published article IDs in one call. Returns items with id, title, meta_description, image_id, language, path and updated. Draft IDs are denied. Empty meta_description needs editorial attention.

structuredContent.name: cms_list_articles
structuredContent.description: List published article IDs and titles for a content metadata audit. Paginate with offset and limit (maximum 12). Returns items, total and next_offset (null at the end). Drafts are excluded by the server.

structuredContent.name: cms_get_media
structuredContent.description: Read up to 12 public media records in one batch. Returns items with id, alt, file_name, width and height. An empty alt needs accessibility review. Join article image_id to media id.

items.text: The available tools exclude drafts and return at most 12 records per call. I’ll paginate through all published articles, join their hero-image records, and flag absent or whitespace-only descriptions and alt text. The PHP will also check that the audited count matches the reported total.
